_: Carrier sentences. A beat with no authored prose renders its frame, so these are the most-read text in the game by a wide margin — `leaf` alone covers 396 of 446 places. Slots: {here} the concept you are standing at, {next} where the guaranteed exit leads, {branch} where a gated branch leads. Slot contents are what MASKS, so the sentence around them must stand on its own; read every line with the braces blacked out before changing it. Follows docs/VOICE.md: depth is the clock, no quantities in prose, no word implying calibrated doubt, present tense at an unresolved fork.

arrival.title: Intake
arrival.body: Everything is ⟦{here}⟧ until we say otherwise. It is the one word nobody has asked us to check. Below it the work divides, and the division goes on file under your name.

descent.title: Filed Below
descent.body: ⟦{here}⟧ holds. What sits under it has not been checked by anyone, and the machines are filing there while you stand here.

threshold.title: Stopped Matching
threshold.body: The graph's ⟦{here}⟧ and the one you were taught have stopped matching. Nothing on file says which is serving. You settle it by going down.

leaf.title: The Tree Stops
leaf.body: Under ⟦{here}⟧ the tree stops. Whatever you take from here does not divide again, and what it means is whatever the graph last said it meant.
